patient_text_en: I was walking back from the mosque and suddenly my chest felt like someone was sitting on it. The pain is shooting up into my jaw and I feel so dizzy I can barely stand up. I need a doctor right now, my heart is pounding so fast.

For the past week, these dry, itchy patches have been spreading on my hands and wrists. I thought it was just from washing dishes, but it's getting worse and the skin is cracking. It's really annoying, but it's not painful.

Since yesterday, the whole right side of my face feels numb and tingling, like when your foot falls asleep. I also have this horrible headache right behind my eye that won't go away with painkillers. It's really worrying me.

My little girl has been burning up with a fever since last night and she won't stop crying. She's breathing really fast and her lips look a little blue. Please help us, she won't even drink water and I'm terrified.
I was lifting some heavy boxes at the shop yesterday and heard a loud pop in my lower back. Now the pain is so sharp I can't even bend over to tie my shoes, and the pain shoots down my right leg.

I was working on the tractor in the village and my leg got crushed under a heavy metal part. The bleeding just won't stop no matter how hard we press on it, and I feel like I'm going to pass out. For God's sake, help me quickly!

I was washing the carpets for Nowruz yesterday and since last night I've been having these terrible cramps in my lower belly. Now I'm bleeding really heavily, way out of my normal cycle. It's making me so weak and I'm honestly quite scared.

I was just walking through the bazaar to buy some bread, but my chest suddenly felt like a heavy rock was placed on it. I'm sweating cold bullets and my left arm is throbbing with pain. Please call someone, my heart is failing me.

My daughter was playing near the sheep pens two days ago and now she has these red, scaly circles all over her stomach. They itch so much she keeps scratching them until they bleed. It's not an emergency, but it's really bothering her sleep.

My mother was just pouring tea and suddenly the glass slipped from her hand. Now the right side of her face is drooping and her speech is completely slurred like she has pebbles in her mouth. We need help immediately, I think she's having a stroke!

I slipped on the wet tiles while making wudu at the mosque this morning and twisted my knee badly. It's swollen up like a melon now and I can't put any weight on it at all. The pain is just a constant ache that won't let up.

For the past few weeks, I keep having these sudden panic attacks where my heart races and I feel like I'm choking. I can't sleep at all because I have this terrible feeling of doom, like something bad will happen to my family. I really need to talk to someone, I'm losing my mind.

My son's right ear has been hurting since yesterday after he went swimming in the river with his cousins. His nose is also a bit stuffy and he says his ear feels blocked, like there's water stuck inside. He doesn't have a high fever, just crying from the discomfort.

Lately I've been drinking jugs of water but my mouth is still completely dry, and I'm running to the bathroom constantly, even at night. I also noticed my vision gets blurry when I read the newspaper. I think my blood sugar might be completely out of control.

My little girl has had a runny nose and a mild cough for the last three days. Today she woke up with a slight fever and doesn't want to eat her breakfast, just wants to lie down. She's breathing fine, but she's just very tired and cranky.

Oh my God, I was just driving the taxi near Azadi Square, and suddenly a motorcycle hit me from the side. My leg twisted really badly, and now I can't move it at all. The pain is killing me, I'm so scared it's broken!

I ate some chicken kebab at that new restaurant in the bazaar yesterday, and since morning, my stomach has been in knots. I've had terrible diarrhea, and I feel so weak and nauseous. I can't even stand properly.
My chest started hurting really bad after lunch today, right in the middle. It feels like a heavy weight, and I'm finding it hard to breathe. My left arm feels tingly too. I'm so worried.
I just can't calm down anymore. I'm constantly worried about everything – my kids, my job, money. My heart keeps racing, and I barely sleep at night. I feel so exhausted and anxious all the time.

My skin has been so itchy for the past few days, especially on my arms and legs. I have these red patches, and some areas are even peeling. I don't know what caused it, maybe a new soap or something from the dusty street.
I've had a sore throat for about four days now, and it's getting worse. It really hurts when I swallow, and my nose is all blocked up. I just feel generally unwell.
My 5-year-old daughter, Mina, has had a very high fever since yesterday evening, almost 39.5. She's coughing a lot and won't eat anything. She seems so weak, and I'm really scared.

I woke up this morning and felt really strange. My right arm and leg feel weak, and I can't move them properly. When I try to talk, my words are all slurred, and I can barely see clearly. This is so frightening.
My period started two days ago, and the pain in my lower abdomen is unbearable, much worse than usual. I'm also bleeding much heavier and feel completely drained. I can barely get out of bed.
I was working on my car, trying to fix the engine, and my hand slipped. The wrench cut my finger really deep. It's bleeding a lot and hurts so much. I think it might need stitches.

Oh God, I was just praying and suddenly this crushing pain came to my chest, like a heavy stone. It's going down my left arm now and I'm finding it hard to breathe. I feel so weak and sweaty, please help me.

My granddaughter says my face looks droopy, and I'm having trouble saying what I want to. Just now, I was making tea and my right arm felt so weak, I almost dropped the tray. I'm a bit scared, to be honest.

My knees, oh my knees! For months now, they've been hurting so much, especially when I try to get up or walk. This morning I wanted to go to the bazaar, but I just couldn't move them, they feel so stiff and swollen. It's really affecting my daily life.

I've been feeling so strange for the past day. I'm terribly thirsty, no matter how much water I drink, and I keep going to the bathroom. My son says my breath smells fruity, and I feel so confused, I can't think straight. I have diabetes, you know.

I just got up from my prayer mat in the middle of the night to get some water, and I slipped and fell so hard. Now my hip hurts terribly, I can't move my leg at all. Please help me, I think I broke something.

It's been a year since my wife passed, and I just can't shake this sadness. I don't feel like eating anything, even my favorite Ghormeh Sabzi, and I just want to stay in bed all day. I don't see the point in anything anymore, to be honest.

Look at this rash on my arm, it's been there for weeks and it just won't go away. It's so itchy and red, and the skin feels rough and scaly. I'm worried it might be something serious because it burns sometimes.
Oh my head! Suddenly the whole room started spinning, I couldn't even stand up. My ears are ringing so loudly, and I feel so nauseous like I'm going to throw up. I've never felt this dizzy before.

For the past few days, I can't catch my breath, especially when I lie down at night. My ankles are so swollen, they look like balloons, and I've gained a lot of weight. Sometimes I even cough up a pinkish phlegm. I take my heart medications, but I don't know what's happening.

My family is worried about me. Lately, I've been forgetting simple things, like where I put my keys or if I've eaten. Just yesterday, I got lost walking home from the mosque, a place I've known for sixty years. Sometimes I say strange things too. I don't understand why this is happening.

My little girl, she's ten months old. راستش yesterday we went to a family gathering and since then she's a bit fussy, not eating her purée much, and has a mild cough. No fever, but I'm just worried, she's usually so active.
My five-year-old son, yesterday he was playing in the yard and fell off the low wall near the flower bed. Since then, he's been limping and saying his leg hurts a lot. There's some swelling too.

My daughter, she's three, has asthma. We were at the park and all of a sudden she started gasping for air, wheezing really bad. Her lips look a bit blue, she can barely talk. Please, you have to help her!

My seven-year-old son has a terrible rash all over his body, especially on his arms and belly. It started a few days after we visited my aunt in the village. He's scratching constantly, it looks like small red blisters.
My eighteen-month-old just woke up screaming from her nap and is pulling at her ear. She had a cold last week and now has a fever. She's inconsolable.
My four-year-old was sitting quietly watching cartoons, and suddenly his eyes rolled back, his body started jerking, and he wasn't responding to us. It lasted about a minute, now he's really drowsy.

My three-month-old baby girl, she's been breathing very fast since birth, and sometimes her lips and around her mouth turn blue, especially when she cries. She also sweats a lot during feeding and gets tired quickly, not gaining weight well.

My six-year-old son, he ate some falafel from a street vendor yesterday, and since morning he's been vomiting non-stop and has severe diarrhea. He's very weak and complaining of bad stomach cramps. He hasn't kept anything down.

My nine-year-old daughter, after my grandmother passed away a month ago, she's been really withdrawn. She used to love playing with her friends and drawing, but now she just stays in her room, barely eats, and has trouble sleeping.
My five-year-old girl keeps complaining of itching 'down there'. It looks a bit red, and she says it hurts when she pees. Maybe it's because she plays in the dirt a lot.
I woke up with a sudden, sharp pain in my lower belly, like something tore. Then some light bleeding started, and I feel dizzy and weak. I'm late on my period by two weeks, and I'm so worried.
It's been two hours since I gave birth, and the bleeding is just not stopping, it's gushing. I feel really dizzy and short of breath. I'm so scared, what if something is wrong?

I just can't cope with the baby anymore, he cries all the time and I feel so guilty and useless. I haven't slept properly in weeks, and sometimes I think it would be better if I wasn't here. My husband says it's just 'baby blues', but it's more than that.

These past few months, my heart keeps racing and I get sharp chest pains, especially when I'm just sitting down or drinking my tea. It scares me, I'm already in menopause for years now. My hands also get sweaty.

My periods have been really heavy for the last few months, I feel drained all the time. I get so dizzy when I stand up, and I can barely do my housework or play with my kids. I feel so weak, even walking to the shop feels like a marathon.

Every month, right before my period, I get these horrible headaches that throb so bad I can't open my eyes. The light kills me, and I feel like throwing up. Even strong painkillers don't help, I just have to lie in a dark room.

I'm seven months pregnant with my second child, and for the past few weeks, I've had terrible pain in my groin and hips. It's so hard to walk, sometimes I hear a clicking sound in my pelvis. I can't even stand for long while cooking.

I'm so embarrassed to call, but under my breasts and in my groin, I have this red, itchy rash that burns. It's been there for a few weeks, and it sometimes gets worse when I leak a little urine. My daughter tried some cream, but it didn't help.

I'm five months pregnant, and my nose has been completely blocked for weeks, I can barely breathe. It's always runny, and I feel pressure in my face. I'm so fed up, I can't sleep properly because of this.
My baby, he's only two months old, has had a fever since morning and won't drink milk. He's usually so active, but now he's just fussy and sleepy. I'm a new mom, and I'm really worried about him.

Oh God, I was just trying to fix the tractor near our field, and then suddenly, my leg got caught! It hurts so much, I can't even stand on it, and it looks really bent. Please help me, I think it's broken.

For weeks now, my hands and arms have been so itchy, especially after working in the garden under the sun. It's gotten worse, and now there are these red patches that don't go away. My daughter says maybe it's from the spray we use for the plants, I don't know.
My son was playing near the sheep pen, and our neighbor's dog just came and bit his leg! He's crying so much, and there's blood, and the bite mark looks deep. He's really scared.

After carrying those heavy sacks of wheat from the barn, I suddenly felt a crushing pain in my chest. It felt like an elephant was sitting on me, and I couldn't catch my breath. It's a bit better now, but I'm still feeling weak.

I've been having unusual bleeding for a few days now, not like my normal period at all. And there's also a dull ache in my lower belly that just won't go away. I'm worried because I've been working hard in the fields.

My husband fell off the roof of our house while he was fixing it! He hit his head really hard, and he was unconscious for a few minutes. Now he's awake but seems confused and keeps asking the same questions. His head is bleeding.

For the past two months, I've had this terrible cough that just won't go away, and I feel so tired all the time, even after resting. I've also lost a lot of weight without trying, and I sometimes get night sweats. I'm worried it's something serious.

I've been having headaches almost every day for the past month, especially when I'm out in the sun. Sometimes I feel dizzy, and my vision gets blurry, like a haze. It makes it hard to focus on my weaving.

Our wheat harvest this year was so bad because of the drought, I've just been so worried and can't sleep at all. I keep thinking about how we'll manage, and I feel this heavy sadness all the time. It's hard to even get out of bed.

My daughter has had a bad earache for two days, and she has a bit of a fever. She says it hurts inside her ear, and she can't hear very well. We went swimming in the local spring ('چشمه') a few days ago, maybe that's it.
I was driving on Azadi Street, and suddenly a motorcycle hit me. My chest hurts so much, and I can't breathe properly. My leg feels completely numb, I'm really scared.
I just finished a really stressful meeting at the office. My chest feels so tight, and the pain is going down my left arm. I'm also a bit short of breath and sweating. I'm worried.

Yesterday we had Kebab from a restaurant in the bazaar, and since midnight I've been feeling terrible. I have terrible stomach pain, constant vomiting, and diarrhea. I also have a fever, I can't even keep water down.
I was walking in the bazaar, and I slipped on some spilled water. My ankle immediately swelled up, and the pain is really bad. I can't put any weight on it, I think I twisted it badly.
For the past two days, I've had this terrible, throbbing headache, mostly on one side. It gets much worse with any light, and I feel nauseous. This always happens during exam time, it's unbearable.
My daughter, who is 5, developed a very red and itchy rash on her arms and legs after playing in the park yesterday. There are small bumps, and she can't stop scratching. It's really bothering her.

For several months now, I've had persistent pain in my lower belly. It gets much worse during my periods, which are also very heavy. I also feel a dull ache in my lower back, it's making daily life difficult.

Since I went to the public pool last week, my right ear has been hurting terribly. It feels like there's water stuck, and I can't hear well from it. There's also some yellowish discharge coming out, it's really bothering me.

Lately, especially when I'm in crowded places like the bazaar or metro, I suddenly feel an intense fear. My heart races, I can't breathe, and I feel dizzy like I'm going to faint. It's happening more often now, and I'm afraid to go out.
My 3-year-old son has had a very high fever, almost 40 degrees, for two days now. He has a terrible, persistent cough and is very lethargic, not eating anything. I'm really worried about him.
Last night, after eating that heavy kebab, I suddenly felt a crushing pain in my chest. It spread to my left arm, and I couldn't catch my breath. It's still there, and I'm really scared.
This morning, while I was making tea, suddenly my right arm and leg felt weak, like they weren't mine. My words got jumbled too, and my husband said my face looked strange. I'm so confused.
I tripped over the edge of the rug yesterday evening when I was getting up to pray. Now my hip hurts so much, I can barely put weight on my leg. It's swollen too.
My foot's been bothering me for months, that wound from my diabetes just won't heal. Now it's gotten worse, there's pus, and I feel hot and feverish. I can't even wear my traditional shoes.
My skin has been so dry and itchy, especially on my arms and legs, for weeks now. It gets worse at night, and sometimes I scratch until it bleeds. I tried a new soap from the bazaar, maybe it's that.
After my husband passed away last year, I just haven't been myself. I can't sleep, I'm constantly worried about everything, and I just feel sad all the time. I miss him so much, I feel so alone.
My right ear has felt blocked and painful for about a week now, and I can't hear things properly. It's like someone put cotton in it. I tried to clean it myself, but it just got worse.

My mother, who has high blood pressure, suddenly got a terrible headache, couldn't see clearly, and started talking nonsense. She took some traditional herb with her regular pills this morning, I'm so worried!

My legs have been really swollen lately, especially by my ankles. I get out of breath just walking to the neighbor's house, and I feel so tired all the time. I think it's because I eat too much salty food.
My knees have been aching for ages, especially when I try to climb the stairs to go to my daughter's house. They feel stiff in the morning, and it's hard to get around. It's old age, I guess.
My 6-month-old, Reza, has been burning up all night. راستش, his fever is so high, it scares me. He's not eating anything and just crying weakly, اصلاً چشم‌هاش باز نمی‌شه.
My daughter, Sara, who's 4, suddenly developed this red, itchy rash all over her body after we visited my aunt's house in Dezful. تو رو خدا، خیلی می‌خارونه و اذیت می‌شه.
My 7-year-old son, Ali, fell off his bike while playing near the Haft Tapeh sugarcane fields. یهو افتاد و الان دست راستش رو اصلاً نمی‌تونه تکون بده و خیلی درد می‌کنه.
My 9-month-old, Fatemeh, is having a really hard time breathing. She's gasping for air and her lips look a bit blue. این نفس‌نفس زدنش اصلاً طبیعی نیست.
My 5-year-old son, Kian, just had a seizure. His body was stiff and then twitching, and he lost consciousness for a minute. راستش، خیلی ترسیدم، تو رو خدا بگید چی شده.
My 8-year-old daughter, Mina, keeps saying her chest hurts, especially when she runs around or gets excited. Sometimes she says her heart is 'beating fast'. دیروز بعد از خوردن نان محلی هم اینطوری شد.
My 3-year-old, Leila, has been tugging at her ear all day and crying. She has a bit of a fever too, and اصلاً شب خواب نداره از درد.
My 6-year-old son, Arian, has been really withdrawn and scared since the big dog barked at him in the bazaar. He doesn't want to go to school and has nightmares every night. اصلاً حرف نمی‌زنه.

My 10-month-old, Zahra, has had really loose, watery stools for two days now, about 5-6 times a day. She's still drinking her milk, but I'm worried she's getting dehydrated. صبحانه کله‌پاچه هم خوردیم.
My 5-year-old daughter, Shadi, has had some yellowish discharge down there and says it stings when she pees. راستش، یهو اینجوری شد و نگرانم.

Oh my God, doctor! I just entered my second month of pregnancy. Yesterday, after eating Qormeh Sabzi with my family for the 'Cheleh' gathering, I started bleeding a little. Today it's gotten worse, and I have a sharp pain in my lower belly. I'm so scared, is my baby okay?

It's been two months since my baby was born, but I feel so empty. I can't sleep, I don't want to eat, and I just cry all the time. My husband says I should be happy, but I can't be. The baby cries, and I just feel numb. I feel like no one understands me.

Lately, I've been so tired that I can barely get through the day. I used to enjoy taking care of my home and praying, but now I just want to sleep. My hair is falling out a lot, and I've gained weight even though I haven't changed my diet much. My hands and feet feel cold all the time, even though I'm always wearing warm clothes.

I'm about 6 weeks pregnant, and suddenly, I got this terrible, sharp pain on one side of my lower belly. It's so bad I almost fainted. I was just at a wedding, eating 'Kabab Barg', and then this hit me. I'm feeling really dizzy now. Is this normal?

It's been a week since I gave birth, and I'm really struggling to breathe. My legs are so swollen I can barely walk, and my heart feels like it's racing. I get tired just trying to breastfeed my baby. This wasn't happening before.

Every month, right before or during my period, I get these terrible migraines. It's not just a headache; I get nauseous, and light really bothers me. I can't even stand to look at my phone. It's been happening for years, and nothing helps. It stops me from doing anything, even putting henna on my hair.

I'm five months pregnant, and I've noticed these dark patches appearing on my face, especially on my forehead and cheeks. I was just at the bazaar after my ultrasound, and I saw myself in a mirror. It's like my skin has gotten much darker in those spots. Is this normal? Will it go away?

I'm eight months pregnant, and walking has become unbearable. Every step I take, especially when I climb stairs or even turn over in bed, I get this sharp pain in my pelvis and groin. It feels like my bones are separating. I can barely do my daily chores. I've even made a vow to get better.

I'm five months pregnant, and for the past two weeks, my nose has been completely blocked. My head feels heavy, and I have pain around my eyes and forehead. I can't even smell the delicious food my mother made. It started after a family gathering where it was a bit cold. I've tried everything, but it won't clear up.
Oh god, my leg is stuck under the tractor! I tried to move it but the pain is unbearable, and I see a lot of blood. I don't think I can stand up.
I was working in the wheat field all morning, and now I feel so dizzy and tired. My head is throbbing, and my mouth is so dry, I can barely swallow. I feel like I might just collapse.
My little boy was playing near our sheep, and a dog from the neighbor's house bit him! He's crying so much and there's a red mark and a little swelling on his arm. Please help my child.
After I sprayed the fruit trees yesterday, my skin started to itch so much. Now I have these red patches on my arms and chest. It's really annoying.

I was moving heavy sacks of rice, and suddenly felt a crushing pain in my chest. I can't breathe properly, and my left arm started hurting badly. I'm sweating a lot and feel like I'm going to pass out.

I fell from the roof while fixing it, and hit my head really hard. My vision is blurry, and I have a terrible headache. I feel a bit confused and can't quite remember what happened right before the fall.
I'm always so tired from working in the fields, and for the last few months, my periods have been very irregular. Sometimes they don't come at all, and other times they're very light. I'm worried.
I can't sleep at night at all. My mind is constantly racing with worries about the crops and my livestock. I feel restless all the time and just can't calm down.
After I swam in the qanat a few days ago, my ear started hurting really bad. Now it's discharging, and I can barely hear from that side. I also feel a bit feverish.
I was cutting hay with a sickle, and accidentally cut my leg very deeply. It's bleeding so much, I can't stop it with this cloth. I'm afraid I might lose too much blood.
I was just walking back from the bazaar, had some heavy bags, and suddenly this terrible crushing pain hit my chest. It's spreading to my left arm, and I feel really breathless. Please, I'm scared.

I was at work, just looking at my computer screen, and suddenly my vision went blurry in one eye, and then this excruciating headache started. It feels like my head is going to explode, and I can't even stand the light. My arm feels a bit weak too.

I've had this really annoying itchy rash on my hands and forearms for about two weeks now. It started after I was handling some old carpets at the shop. It's red and bumpy, and scratching it only makes it worse. It's driving me crazy!

I just slipped on the stairs at home, right on my ankle. It twisted really badly. Now it's swollen and hurts like crazy whenever I try to put any weight on it. I can barely walk. I hope it's not broken.

My little girl, she's five, has had a high fever since last night. She keeps complaining her throat hurts a lot, and she's struggling to swallow even water. She's really lethargic and just wants to sleep. I'm worried about her.

I've been having some really unusual bleeding for the past few days, not like my normal period at all. It's much heavier and there are some clots. I'm also feeling a bit dizzy and tired. It's making me anxious.

My job at the office has been so stressful lately, I can't sleep properly anymore. My mind just races, and I'm constantly worried about everything. I feel on edge all the time, and sometimes I just can't focus on anything. I'm so tired of feeling like this.

I'm a driver, and a few days ago, a truck horn blasted right next to my ear when my window was open. Since then, my ear has been ringing constantly, it hurts inside, and I feel like my hearing on that side is much worse. It's really bothering me.

I ate some falafel from a street vendor in the bazaar a couple of days ago, and ever since, I've had this constant upset stomach and bloating. I feel nauseous sometimes, but I haven't thrown up. It's just a general discomfort that won't go away.
Oh god, I ate a big Abgoosht for lunch, and now my chest feels so heavy, like a big rock is sitting on it. It's really hard to breathe, and my left arm is getting numb too. Please, I'm so scared.

My mother, she was just talking to me about the neighbors, and then suddenly her face dropped on one side. She can't lift her right arm, and her words are all jumbled. This happened so fast, I'm so worried.
I just got up from my prayer rug after evening prayers, and my leg just gave out from under me. I fell hard on my hip. Now I can't stand up at all, and it hurts so bad, swelling up already.

My foot, it's been getting worse. I have diabetes, you know. There's this sore on my big toe that just won't heal, and it's all red and feels like it's burning. I walked a lot in the bazaar yesterday, maybe that's why.

My skin has been so itchy lately, especially on my arms and back. I don't know what it is, maybe something I ate at my sister's house? It's all red and dry, feels like small bumps and scales are forming.

I've been so on edge lately, I can't even sleep properly. My heart keeps pounding for no reason, and I feel like something terrible is going to happen any minute. I can't even sit down to drink my tea quietly.

My ears have been ringing constantly for weeks, like a cricket is stuck in there. And honestly, it's getting harder to hear what my grandkids are saying, even the TV has to be super loud. Sometimes I feel a bit dizzy too.

Oh my stomach hurts so bad, like never before. I've been throwing up all night and can't keep anything down. I think it was that food I ate yesterday, maybe the leftover Kuku. I feel so weak and lightheaded.
I'm 75 years old, and I haven't had my periods in decades. But last week, I suddenly saw some spotting, like blood. It's not much, but it really scared me. I've never had this before since menopause.

My grandson, he's only 2 years old. He has a very high fever since last night, and he's coughing a lot. He's breathing very fast, and he doesn't want to drink his milk or eat anything. I'm really worried about him.

My six-month-old daughter has had a very high fever since last night, like 40 degrees. She's not eating anything, just sleeping and crying weakly when I try to wake her. I'm so worried, please help us!
My two-year-old son has been crying non-stop for hours and keeps pulling at his ear. He also has a low fever. We were playing in the garden earlier, maybe something got in there?
My son, he's eight, fell badly on his ankle while playing football with his friends in the alley this afternoon. Now his ankle is swollen, and he can't put any weight on it, it hurts him so much.

My four-year-old daughter has this really itchy red rash all over her body, especially on her arms and legs. She keeps scratching it non-stop. We went to my aunt's house last week, maybe she touched something there?

My baby, he's 10 months old, suddenly started choking on a small piece of plastic, I think. Now he's struggling to breathe, his lips look a bit blue, and he's making a wheezing sound. Oh my god, please hurry!
My seven-year-old daughter woke up this morning and can't move the left side of her body properly. Her face looks a bit droopy, and her words are slurred, it's very scary. She was fine last night.
My five-month-old baby girl breathes really fast all the time, even when she's just lying down. Sometimes her lips look a bit blue, especially when she's feeding. She also sweats a lot when she eats.

My six-year-old son has had severe stomach pain, vomiting, and diarrhea for the past three days. He's very weak and barely eats anything. We think it was that sandwich he bought from the street vendor.

My eleven-year-old daughter has completely changed lately. She used to be so bubbly and loved playing with her friends, but now she just stays in her room, doesn't want to go to school, and sleeps a lot. She looks so sad all the time.
My little girl, she's three, has some yellowish discharge and is complaining that it stings when she pees. She also keeps scratching herself down there. I'm not sure what it is.
I'm about 8 weeks pregnant and suddenly had heavy bleeding with terrible lower belly pain. I'm really scared, please help me, I don't want to lose my baby!
I'm 55 and for a few months now, I've been having terrible hot flashes, especially at night. I can't sleep at all and I'm always irritable. It's hard to even prepare food in the kitchen.
My baby was born two months ago, but I don't feel happy at all. I just want to cry, and I have no energy. I feel like I can't connect with my baby, and everyone expects me to be joyful.
My back has been hurting for a long time, especially after I do chores like making bread all morning. It feels stiff and sometimes I can barely bend down. I'm 68 years old.
I'm 6 months pregnant and my skin, especially my belly and legs, is so itchy! I've tried some traditional remedies, but nothing helps. It's driving me crazy, particularly at night.

I was making bread over the tanour (clay oven), and my hand brushed against the hot side. Now it's red, hurts, and a small blister has formed. I just need someone to check it.

I was driving my motorbike near Azadi Square when a taxi suddenly cut me off. I fell really hard. My leg hurts so bad, I can't even move it, and it's swelling up fast. I'm afraid it's broken, تو رو خدا کمک کنید.
Yesterday, I ate some kebab from that shop in the bazaar, and ever since, my stomach has been killing me. I've had terrible diarrhea all night, and I feel feverish. I'm so weak, I can barely stand.

I just climbed the stairs to my apartment, and suddenly I got this terrible crushing pain in my chest. It's radiating to my left arm, and I can't catch my breath. I'm sweating all over, I'm really scared.
My son, Amir, just came home from school, and he has a really high fever. His whole body is covered in a red rash, and he's complaining about his throat. He won't eat anything, I'm so worried.
For the past few days, I've had this really itchy red rash on my hands and neck. It burns sometimes, and my skin feels so dry and flaky. I don't know what caused it, maybe a new soap?
I woke up this morning, and half of my face feels numb and saggy. I can't lift my right arm properly, and my family says I'm speaking strangely. I feel so confused, یهو اینجوری شدم.

My right ear has been hurting terribly for two days, it feels blocked, and I can barely hear anything. There's some yellow stuff coming out, and I've been feeling a bit dizzy. راستش، بعد از حمام رفتن اینجوری شدم.

I'm always worried, especially with exams coming up, and I can't sleep at all, no matter how tired I am. My heart sometimes pounds really fast, and I just can't focus on anything anymore. اصلاً حالم خوب نیست.

I've been having really bad pain in my lower belly for a few weeks, and my periods have become super heavy and irregular. I feel so tired all the time, and my stomach feels bloated. It's really bothering me.

I was walking in the bazaar near the fruit stalls and slipped on some water, hitting my head on the ground. I didn't pass out, but I have a small bump and a dull headache now. I just want to make sure everything's okay, تو رو خدا.

I was kneading dough for bread, and suddenly my chest started hurting terribly, like someone is squeezing my heart. It's radiating to my left arm, and I feel really out of breath, like I can't breathe. I'm so scared, what's happening to me?

I was just sitting, watching TV and drinking tea, when suddenly my right arm and leg went completely weak. I tried to speak to my wife, but my tongue felt heavy and my words were all slurred. My face feels strange on one side too.
Oh God, I just got up to pray and slipped on the rug right here at home. My hip hurts so much, I can't even move my leg an inch. It's swollen already, I think I broke something, please help me.

I had a small cut on my foot from my sandal a few weeks ago after visiting the bazaar, but now it's turned really bad. It's all red and swollen, and there's yellow pus coming out. My diabetes makes me worried about this. I'm really scared it won't heal.

My back has been so itchy for weeks, I just can't stop scratching. It's all red and bumpy now, and my skin feels so dry everywhere. I've tried olive oil and everything, but it's not going away. It's driving me crazy, I can't sleep properly.

Lately I can't hear my grandchildren well when they talk, it's like my ears are blocked. And sometimes when I'm walking in the garden, I feel a bit dizzy and unbalanced, like the world is spinning. It's really bothering me.

Since my Agha Jan passed away a few months ago, I just don't have the will to do anything. I don't feel like eating, I've lost weight, and I just stare at the ceiling all night, can't sleep. Everything feels hopeless, I'm so tired all the time.

I'm 75, and I thought menopause was long over, but for the past few days, I've had some vaginal bleeding. It's not heavy, but it's constant, and I also feel a dull pain in my lower belly. Please, I'm so scared, what could this be?

(Caller, wife of patient) My husband, who is 70 and takes blood thinners for his stroke history, got up too fast and hit his head really hard on the door frame. Now he's acting confused and keeps asking the same questions. His blood thinner worries me.

(Caller, grandfather of patient) Oh God help me, I made a terrible mistake! My little grandson, who is only three, had a slight fever. I accidentally gave him *my* arthritis pills instead of his children's pain reliever. He seems okay now, just a small rash and still a bit warm, but I'm so worried, what should I do?

My baby girl, she's only 4 months old, has had a very high fever since last night, like 39.5. She's not feeding well at all and just cries weakly, it's heartbreaking. She's usually so active, but now she's just limp.
My son, he's 6, was playing football in the alley with his friends and fell badly on his arm. He's been crying ever since, says it hurts a lot, and he can't move it. It looks a bit swollen too.
My 3-year-old daughter got these red, itchy spots all over her tummy and back, especially after we ate that new type of berry from the market yesterday. She keeps scratching it, poor thing.

My 10-month-old baby had a terrible episode just now! He had a fever, and then his whole body started shaking, and his eyes rolled back. It lasted only a minute or so, but it was so scary, I thought I'd lose him.
My 2-year-old daughter caught a cold a few days ago, and now she's been screaming in pain and constantly pulling at her right ear. She can't sleep because of the pain, and nothing seems to help.
My 6-month-old baby boy has been breathing very fast and seems to struggle, especially when he's resting. His lips look a bit blue sometimes, and he has a cough that won't go away. He's always tired.

My 8-year-old daughter, she's usually so cheerful, but for the past few days, she's been very quiet and withdrawn. She doesn't want to play with her friends, and just sits by herself. I'm worried something happened when she was coming back from school.
My 4-year-old girl has been complaining that her private area is itchy, and I noticed a little bit of discharge. She plays a lot in the dirt outside, so maybe that's it, but I'm concerned.

My son, he's 7, usually eats everything, but for the last month, he's lost a lot of weight even though he eats his Kufteh. He's always tired, just wants to sleep, and doesn't have the energy to play like before. I don't know what's wrong.
Oh God, please help! My 2-year-old daughter just drank some of that floor cleaner from under the sink. She coughed and started crying, and now she's a bit dizzy. What should I do?!
Oh my god, I was just making 'qeymeq' for lunch and suddenly felt a sharp pain in my stomach. Now I'm bleeding heavily and feel dizzy. Please help me, I'm pregnant and so scared!

It's only been a few days since I gave birth, and now I suddenly can't catch my breath. My chest hurts really bad, and one of my legs is swollen. I was just trying to put my baby in the 'gohvareh'. I'm so worried about my child.

I'm always tired, absolutely drained. My whole body feels hot, especially at night, and my periods are totally unpredictable now. I swear, I snap at everyone around me these days. I was trying to make 'doogh', but I just felt too exhausted to move.

My head is throbbing so bad, and I can't see properly, everything's blurry. I also have a sharp pain right under my ribs, and my hands and feet are so swollen I can't even wear my slippers. I was at the 'bazar' shopping for the baby and got so scared.

I've always had headaches, but lately, especially around my period, they're unbearable. It's only on one side of my head, and I see flashing lights before it starts. The light hurts my eyes so much, and I feel like throwing up. I had to stop making 'ghazalagh' because I couldn't bear it.

My belly and arms are covered in these red, itchy bumps, it drives me crazy, especially at night! I can't sleep because of the itching, and my skin feels so dry. I even tried putting 'zard-choobeh' paste on it like my mother said, but it's not helping. I'm pregnant and so uncomfortable.

Ever since I gave birth, my lower back and hips constantly ache. It's so bad, I have trouble walking, and just trying to pick up my baby hurts a lot. My hips feel really stiff in the mornings. I can't even sit comfortably on the 'sofreh' for meals anymore.

It's been weeks since I had my baby, and I just feel empty inside. I cry all the time for no reason, and I don't feel connected to my baby at all. My husband says I'm not myself. I don't even feel like celebrating 'Nowruz' anymore, what's wrong with me?

My throat is always dry, like there's something stuck in it, and my voice has gotten so raspy. It's bothering me when I talk, even gossiping with my neighbors is hard. I drink so much 'chai' but it doesn't help the dryness, and swallowing my pills is a real struggle.

My daughter's periods are so painful she can't even go to school, and she bleeds through everything. Her mom tried giving her 'nabat' tea, but it's not helping at all. She also gets really moody before her period. My mom is very worried.

I was lifting sacks of wheat all morning, and suddenly this terrible pain started in my chest, going up to my jaw. I can't breathe properly, and I feel so weak. It's like a heavy stone on my chest, never felt anything like it.

My tractor overturned in the field while I was plowing, and my leg got stuck underneath. I think it's broken, it's bent at a weird angle and bleeding a lot. The pain is unbearable, I can't move it at all.

My hands and arms have been so itchy and red for weeks since I started harvesting the saffron. It gets worse after I've been out in the sun all day. It's really bothering me, especially at night, I can't sleep.

My 6-year-old son was playing near the sheep and one of them headbutted him. He has a deep cut on his forehead and it's bleeding a lot. He's crying and keeps saying his head hurts, and he seems a bit sleepy now.
After spraying the fields yesterday with pesticide, I started feeling really dizzy and confused. Now I have a terrible headache, blurry vision, and my muscles feel weak.

I'm about three months pregnant, and yesterday I fell from a ladder while picking apples in the orchard. Now I have really bad abdominal pain and I'm bleeding quite a bit. To God, I'm so worried about the baby.

Since my sheep died from the drought a few months ago, I haven't been able to sleep. I feel hopeless all the time, no energy to do anything. I just sit and stare, don't want to talk to anyone. My family says I've changed a lot.

I was working on the threshing machine all day, and now my ear feels blocked and I have a sharp pain inside. I think something got in there, it's making me dizzy too and I can't hear well from that ear.

I spent the whole day working in the fields under the scorching sun, gathering herbs. Now I feel incredibly weak, lightheaded, and my head is pounding. I feel sick to my stomach and haven't peed much all day.

I slipped on a wet rock near the stream and twisted my ankle really badly. It's quite swollen and hurts a lot when I put weight on it, but I can still walk slowly. I just want to make sure it's not broken and get some relief.

I was just walking in the bazaar, near the spice shop, when a motorcycle hit me from behind. Now my leg, especially below the knee, hurts so much, I can't even stand on it. It looks a bit crooked too, تو رو خدا کمک کنید!
Yesterday, I ate ghormeh sabzi at that new restaurant near the university. Since then, I've had terrible stomach cramps, nausea, and can't stop going to the bathroom. I feel weak.
My son, he's 3, was playing with a 500 Toman coin just now and I think he swallowed it! He's not coughing or anything, but I'm so worried, what if it gets stuck?
After an hour stuck in traffic near Azadi Square, I suddenly felt this crushing pain in my chest. It's going down my left arm and I can't catch my breath. I'm really scared.
I changed my laundry detergent last week, and now my hands and arms are covered in this incredibly itchy rash. It's red and bumpy, and it's driving me crazy!
For the past few months, my periods have been really heavy and unpredictable, sometimes lasting too long. Plus, I have this constant dull ache in my lower belly that just won't go away.

I've been working so much on the computer, and for the last five days, I've had a constant, throbbing headache. Sometimes my vision gets blurry, especially when I'm tired. It's really affecting my work.
After that dust storm last week, my right ear started hurting badly, and I can't hear well out of it. It feels blocked, like there's water in it, and sometimes I get dizzy.
I'm a student, and with all the exams, I'm finding it really hard to focus. I feel constantly overwhelmed and worried, and can't even sleep properly at night. My grades are slipping.

I was rushing to catch a shared taxi (خطی) near the train station, slipped on the wet pavement, and hit my head really hard. I think I blacked out for a second, and now I feel confused and very dizzy.

Oh, dear. I was just walking to the mosque like every day, and suddenly my chest started hurting badly, like a heavy stone. And my left arm feels numb, I can't even breathe right. This is new, I'm scared.
After breakfast, I suddenly felt my right side go weak. My mouth feels crooked, and when I try to talk, it's all muddled. My daughter is here, she's worried sick.
I was just getting up from the carpet to pray, and I tripped on my own foot. Fell hard on my hip. Now it hurts so much, I can't stand up. راستش، فکر کنم شکسته.
My foot, the one with diabetes, has a sore that won't heal for weeks. Now it's swollen and red, and I feel hot and cold. I'm worried it's getting worse.
Since my husband passed away last month, I just don't feel like eating, and I sometimes talk to myself. My children say I'm getting confused more often. I don't know what's happening to me.
For weeks now, I hear a constant ringing in my ears, especially when it's quiet. And I feel like my hearing is getting worse, can't hear the TV well. It's really annoying.
My legs are so dry and itchy, especially with this cold winter air. I've been scratching them a lot, and now there's a red rash. It's really bothering me.
I haven't had my period for years, but for the past few weeks, I've had some light spotting. It's just a little, but it's making me anxious. I hope it's nothing serious.
My 5-year-old son has had a high fever since last night, and he's coughing a lot. He also complains that his throat hurts when he tries to swallow. He's very sleepy.
Suddenly, I got this terrible stomach ache, like nothing I've felt before. I've been vomiting constantly and have really bad diarrhea. I feel so weak, I can barely stand. Please help me.

My baby, only 8 months old, has been having severe diarrhea and throwing up everything since last night. He's so weak, doesn't even want to drink milk, and his diapers are dry. I'm really worried, what should I do?

My daughter, she's 5, got this red, itchy rash all over her body after we went for a picnic by the river yesterday. It's not bothering her breathing or anything, but she keeps scratching and complaining it burns a little.
My son, he's 2, keeps pulling at his ear and crying non-stop, especially when I try to lay him down. He had a fever last night too. We took him to the public pool a few days ago, maybe that's it?
My daughter, 7 years old, fell from a small tree in the garden while playing. Her arm looks twisted, and it's already swollen. She's in so much pain, she can't even move it. Please help her!

My 18-month-old son just had a really scary episode. He was shaking all over and his eyes rolled back, didn't respond for about a minute. He had a high fever. Now he's just really sleepy. Is this a seizure?

My 9-year-old daughter keeps telling me her chest hurts sometimes, especially when she runs with her friends. She says her heart beats really fast and she gets tired quickly. It's been happening for a few days now.
My 3-year-old just swallowed a small button battery, I think it was from the TV remote. He started coughing and drooling a lot right after. Please, we need help immediately!

My 6-year-old daughter hasn't been herself for a few weeks. She has a low fever almost every day, looks very pale, and doesn't want to eat anything. She's always tired, even after sleeping a lot. I'm really worried about her general health.

My 8-year-old son has completely changed after that big argument we had at home last week. He's so quiet, doesn't play with his toys, and refuses to go to school. He just sits in his room and cries sometimes. I don't know what to do.

My 4-year-old daughter has some unusual yellowish discharge in her private area, and it looks really red and irritated. She keeps complaining it's itchy and sometimes it hurts when she pees. I'm very concerned.
I'm 28 weeks pregnant and suddenly, while I was cooking ghormeh sabzi, I felt a sharp pain in my lower belly. Then I saw some blood, like a period. I'm really scared, please help!

It's been three months since I gave birth to my daughter, and I'm just constantly exhausted. I feel cold all the time, my hair is falling out a lot, and I just can't get my energy back even though I try to eat well. My baby is fine, but I'm not.

I had a positive pregnancy test last week. This morning, I suddenly felt this excruciating pain on my right side, like something burst. I got dizzy and almost fainted, and then I started bleeding heavily. My shoulder even hurts now, it's so weird.

My baby is two months old, and everyone says I should be happy, but I just feel empty and sad all the time. I cry for no reason, and sometimes I even feel like I can't connect with my own child. I just want to sleep and escape.

Ever since I got pregnant, I've noticed dark spots on my face, especially on my cheeks and forehead, like a mask. And my skin is breaking out a lot, even though I'm usually careful with my skincare. It makes me self-conscious.

I'm 36 weeks pregnant, and for the past few days, I've been feeling really breathless, even when just sitting or trying to pray. My ankles are super swollen, and sometimes my heart feels like it's racing or pounding. I'm worried about the baby.

I'm 62 and well past menopause, but lately, I've been getting these terrible headaches, way worse than before. They come with flashing lights in my eyes and such bad nausea I can't even eat my usual afternoon tea and dates. It's debilitating.

I'm 30 weeks pregnant, and my hips and lower back just constantly ache, especially when I'm walking around the bazaar or trying to turn over in bed. Sometimes I hear a click in my pelvis. It's getting really hard to move.

I'm 50 and probably in perimenopause. Lately, I've had constant ringing in my ears, and sometimes I get really dizzy for no reason, like the room is spinning. My hearing also feels a bit off. It's quite unsettling.

My 6-year-old daughter keeps complaining that her private parts itch, and it looks a bit red. Sometimes I notice a yellowish discharge, and she says it stings when she pees. I'm worried something is wrong.

Oh god, my leg! I was just working on the tractor in the field, moving hay, when a piece of it just... caught my leg. I can't move it at all, and it's bent in a weird way. It hurts so bad, I'm gonna faint.

I was fixing the roof of our barn, it's pretty old you know, and I slipped. Hit my head hard when I fell onto the ground. I was out for a bit, my wife says, and now I feel all confused and my vision's blurry.

After working hard in the fields all day, I suddenly felt this crushing pain in my chest. It's radiating down my left arm, and I can barely breathe. I'm sweating like crazy even though it's not that hot anymore.

I'm a shepherd, been out with the sheep all day in the sun near Darbandikhan. I just feel so incredibly weak and dizzy, like I might fall over. My mouth is dry, and I haven't peed much since morning. My wife made me come in.
My son, he's only five, was playing near our neighbour's guard dog. The dog bit him on the arm! It's bleeding a lot, and he's crying nonstop. I'm so worried about him, please help.

I've been helping my husband move heavy sacks of wheat, and now I have a terrible pain in my lower belly. I also noticed a little bit of spotting. I'm three months pregnant, and I'm so scared something's wrong with the baby.

My mother, she was fine just an hour ago, eating her kubba. Then suddenly her face looked a bit droopy, and she couldn't speak clearly. Her left arm also felt weak. It got a little better after a while, but she's still not right.
I was spraying pesticides in the orchard last week, and now I have this terrible, itchy red rash all over my arms and neck. It burns sometimes, and I'm really uncomfortable, especially in the sun.

I was working outside near the fields, you know, harvesting corn. Suddenly I felt something fly into my ear. Now my ear hurts really bad, and it feels like something is still stuck inside. I can't hear well from that ear.

For months now, I've just felt so sad and hopeless. The harvest was bad again, and I worry constantly about my family. I can't sleep properly, and I've lost all interest in doing anything, even going to the market.

Oh my God, I was just driving to the bazaar, and a taxi hit me hard! My leg, it just folded. I can't even stand, the pain is unbearable. It looks really bad, like it's not straight anymore. Please, help me!

Yesterday, I had a falafel from that cart near the office, and since midnight, I've been so sick. My stomach hurts like crazy, and I can't stop throwing up or going to the bathroom. I feel so weak and dizzy now.

I've been so stressed with the shop lately, the rent and all. Suddenly, this terrible pain in my chest started, moving to my left arm. I can't catch my breath, and I'm sweating cold. I feel like I'm going to throw up.
After swimming last week, my right ear started to hurt, and it feels a bit blocked, like I can't hear well. It's also really itchy inside. I've tried cleaning it but it hasn't helped.

My little girl, she's only 5, has had a really high fever since yesterday. Now, a red rash has appeared all over her body. She also says her throat hurts, and she's not eating anything at all. I'm so worried!

I changed my laundry detergent last week, and now my hands and arms are covered in this incredibly itchy red rash. My skin feels really dry and flaky, and it burns sometimes, especially after washing dishes.

I've been staring at the computer all day, but suddenly, this terrible, blinding headache hit me. I'm seeing strange flashing lights in my vision, and my fingers feel a bit numb. I also feel really nauseous.

My period has been really heavy for the past two weeks, much more than usual, and I'm having terrible pain in my lower belly. I feel so tired all the time and sometimes I even get dizzy when I stand up quickly. I'm really worried.

The university exams are next month, and I'm constantly worried. Sometimes, my heart starts racing, and I can't catch my breath, like I'm having a panic attack. I can't sleep properly anymore, and it's affecting my studies.

I was just doing accounts for the shop when suddenly this excruciating pain in my right lower belly hit me. It's getting worse, and I feel feverish. I haven't wanted to eat anything all day, and my stomach feels hard as a rock. I'm so scared.

Oh my God, I was just praying and suddenly felt this crushing pain in my chest, like a heavy stone. I can't breathe properly, and I feel so dizzy, like I'm going to collapse. My family needs me, please help!
I was having tea with my daughter, and my right hand suddenly felt weak, couldn't hold the cup. And my words, they just came out jumbled. It's not like a full stroke again, is it? I'm so scared.
I slipped on the carpet near the bathroom last night and fell. My hip hurts so much, I couldn't get up at all. My son had to help me. Now even sitting up is agony, I can't put any weight on it.

I feel terrible, so weak and tired. I've been drinking water constantly, but my mouth is still so dry. I keep going to the toilet, like every half hour. My sugar must be high, I had too much 'zulbia bamieh' yesterday.

This sore on my foot has been there for weeks now, maybe even a month. It's not healing, and the skin around it looks a bit dark. It doesn't hurt much, but I'm worried it might get worse, especially with my diabetes.

I got up from my prayer mat this morning and suddenly the room started spinning badly. I felt so dizzy and nauseous, like I was going to vomit. My ears are ringing too. I just can't stand straight without feeling like I'll fall.

Honestly, since my wife passed away, nothing feels right. I don't want to go to the mosque, don't want to see friends. I just sit at home. I can't sleep properly, and even food doesn't taste good anymore. What's the point?

This is a bit embarrassing, but for the past month, I've had some pain in my lower belly. And then, the other day, I saw some blood, like a period, but I haven't had one for twenty years! I'm really worried, 'to ro khoda' help me.

I can't breathe! It feels like there's an elephant on my chest. My lips feel tingly and my son says they're turning blue. I can't even finish a sentence without gasping. I was just smoking my 'ghalyan' and suddenly it got worse.
I just don't feel right. My body aches all over, I have a mild headache, and my stomach feels a bit upset. It started a few days after I changed my blood pressure medication dose. Could it be that?
My 3-month-old son has had a very high fever since last night, and he's not eating at all. He's just crying and so fussy, I'm really worried.
My 3-year-old daughter just ate a piece of that wedding sweet, and suddenly her lips swelled up, and she's struggling to breathe. She has a terrible rash all over her body too. I'm so scared!
My 6-year-old son fell while playing Haft-Sang (a traditional game) in the alley. He can't put weight on his leg, it's really hurting him, and it's starting to swell. He's been limping since.
My 8-month-old baby girl has a terrible rash all over her body that started small but now it's red and itchy, almost like blisters. She's so uncomfortable and crying a lot.
My 4-year-old son has been complaining of terrible ear pain for two days. He keeps pulling on his ear, and he has a fever too. He doesn't let us sleep at all at night.
My 2-year-old daughter suddenly started shaking all over her body and staring blankly. She didn't respond to anything. It lasted a few minutes, and I'm so scared her brain might be damaged.
My 7-year-old daughter says her 'down there' is burning and itchy since yesterday. There's also some discharge, and she feels uncomfortable when she pees. She's in elementary school.
My 9-year-old son has had a cough for almost three weeks now, it's not getting better with home remedies. He's also constantly tired and has lost some weight. He's in third grade.
My 10-year-old daughter keeps telling me her chest hurts, especially when she plays soccer. She also says her heart sometimes races. She feels dizzy when it happens. What's wrong?
My 5-year-old son completely changed after he saw that car accident last week. He's withdrawn, has nightmares, and is terrified of strangers. He doesn't play with anyone at all anymore.

It's been two months since my baby girl was born, but I feel empty and sad all the time. I used to love baking Nan-e Berenji for Nowruz, but now I don't even want to hold my baby, let alone cook. My mother-in-law keeps saying I'm just tired, but this is more than tiredness. تو رو خدا کمکم کنید.

I'm 7 months pregnant, and suddenly last night, I got a horrible, sharp pain in my lower belly that won't go away. I also started bleeding a little and felt really dizzy, almost fainted when I tried to get water from the kitchen. My husband took me to the village clinic, but they said I need more help.

My periods have always been heavy, but for the past few months, it's been excessive. I feel so weak and tired, sometimes even walking up the stairs to our apartment feels like a marathon. My hands and face look really pale, my neighbor told me I look like a ghost.

I'm 55 and for the past year, since my periods stopped, my joints, especially my knees and fingers, ache constantly, especially after I help my daughter make 'gheimeh'. And these sudden hot flashes, they come out of nowhere, even when it's cold. I just want some relief.

About a week ago, while I was showering after working in the garden, I felt a small, hard lump in my left breast. It doesn't hurt, but I'm really worried. My aunt had breast cancer, so I'm scared to even tell my family. Please tell me what it is.

I'm 32 weeks pregnant. This morning, I woke up with a pounding headache behind my eyes, and my vision became really blurry, like looking through fog. I even saw some flashing lights when I tried to look out the window. My hands and feet are swollen too, much more than usual.

I'm in my second trimester, and for the last two days, I've had a really bad sore throat, it hurts to even swallow water. My right ear also started hurting this morning. I've been gargling with salt water and drinking 'gol gav zaban' tea, but nothing helps. I don't want to take anything strong because of the baby.

I'm six months pregnant, and for the past week, I've developed this incredibly itchy rash, mostly on my belly and thighs. It looks like small red bumps. It gets much worse at night, making it impossible to sleep. I tried some 'Arde' (sesame paste) my grandmother suggested, but it didn't help.

It's only three weeks since I delivered my twins, and I've been feeling so breathless, even just walking from the bedroom to the living room. Last night, I got a sharp pain in my chest that wouldn't go away for a while, and my heart was racing. My sister says it's just 'ضعف بدنی' (body weakness) from giving birth, but it feels serious.

My daughter is only seven, but for the past few months, I've noticed her breasts are starting to develop, and she's even got some hair down there. She's also grown a lot taller really fast. Other kids her age don't look like this. I'm really worried about her future and what this means.

I was driving the tractor, then the wheel hit a big rock. Suddenly I was thrown from the seat and my leg got caught under the wheel. Please, my right leg is twisted and hurts terribly. I can't move it at all.
After I moved the sacks of wheat, a severe pain twisted in my chest. This pain goes to my left arm and my jaw. I'm also short of breath. I've never felt this way before. It's very heavy.
This morning I was milking, suddenly I saw one side of my face was drooping. I can't speak at all, I'm slurring my words. My right arm is also numb. I'm very scared, please help me.

I've had severe back pain for a while, especially after moving heavy loads. My periods have also been irregular, and suddenly for two days, my lower abdominal pain has become very severe, and I'm bleeding. I'm very worried.
For several years, a dark, rough patch has appeared on my face where the sun always hits. It was small at first, but now it's grown a bit and sometimes itches. I think it's from old sunburns.
